title: AI/ML Research Engineer
description:
***AI/ML Research Engineers with FULL-STACK experience ***

REQUIRED SKILLS:
• 4-year degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience.
• Experience with Agentic frameworks and building agentic AI applications.
• Strong proficiency in Python and prompt engineering for LLMs.
• Ability to differentiate between data models (e.g., Meta vs. OpenAI) based on project requirements.
• Hands on experience with Natural Language Processing and deploying scalable AI models.
• Deep knowledge technologies (SAP HANA, DB2, SQL Server) and solid SQL expertise.
• Experience building agentic AI or AI assistant style products.
• Prior work with Lockheed Martin data platforms (EDE, LDW, EDW) or comparable enterprise scale environments.
• Relevant cloud AI or machine learning certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML)

Desired Skills
• Nodejs
• Predictive Modeling
• Knowledge/Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
• Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast paced, collaborative environment.

title: Technician
description:
This position requires someone who has a good amount of experience with aircraft wiring, specifically constructing wiring harnesses from electrical schematics. Candidate also needs to have experience routing wiring harnesses in a large electronics rack and terminating to a rear disconnect panel. Mechanical skills are also required for mounting items in the racks.

Technician capable of working from engineering drawings, electrical and electronic schematics with limited guidance to fabricate, install, diagnose and repair equipment and test installations in support of System Integration Laboratory test facilities. Must be able to fabricate wire harnesses, test boxes and associated laboratory test equipment.

Basic Qualifications :
Strong electronic and electrical diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.
Previous experience with electronic and electrical fabrication.
Previous experience working in a laboratory or manufacturing environment.
Mechanical and general fabrication skills.
Previous experience working with, fabricating and terminating military wiring harnesses and connectors.
